title: Create Creative Things: Less Garish?!
description: Replaces creative item textures with ones similar to andesite related Create items
body:
"In my younger and more vulnerable years my father gave
me some advice that I’ve been turning over in my mind
ever since.

‘_Andesite textures are cool_,’ he told me,
‘_Make a resorce pack_’"

-Excerpt from The Great Andesite, 1925

I REALLY like building in Creative Mode, but I feel like Creative item textures are a little jarring to see when you look at them next to other, more conventional machinery. 
This mod was made in like 5 minutes and everything in it belongs to Create and it's devs yadda yadda yadda
PLZ do not ask me for anything about this mod.
Im not making ANY alterations >_>
